purpose: Historical supporting evidence for retained gains; no new performance qualification.

accounting.cpu: Sum sampled cgroup CPU deltas for every measured role except minio; broker included.
accounting.peak_rss: Maximum per-sample sum of RSS for every measured role except minio; never subtract separately timed role peaks.
accounting.object_store: MinIO per-role CPU and independent role RSS peak preserved and reported separately; its 2 CPU / 2 GiB budget is excluded from application budget.

limitations: Selected signals use different historical application images and hosts. They are not a combined final-image qualification.
The final retained branch has later upstream correctness fixes, MinIO accounting changes and consumer lifecycle cleanup; these images do not qualify that revision.
Single-node, 60-second steady phases, three repetitions, API-accepted workload with different publication/durability contracts. No confidence intervals or production soak claim.
Later isolated retained hasher and Loki source-label controls contain shared rejected experiments and are intentionally not used for this native comparison table.

metrics.selection_reason: Live-label cache-hit exact-image checkpoint. Later randomized-hasher native images still include rejected cold-label sharing; ordered-scan, dense-metadata, cold-fingerprint, global-CGU and manifest-cache candidate images are excluded. This metrics deployment does not execute the concurrent later-reverted Loki decimal-formatting experiment in this image.
